q1_issues.issue: No participant is represented anywhere — the thanker and the elided addressee who agreed and would come leave all three eventualities with no role atoms at all.

q2_gaps: expressive / formulaic speech acts ("Thanks for ...") — a verbless, non-declarative utterance has no routing; the copular-vs-verbal split, the imperative Directive/Forbid rule and the question rule all miss it
a subjectless gerund clause supplies no controller, so the control-verb rule's "copy the controller's role in" has nothing to copy and the agent of both agree and come is simply lost
notes: For is the right preposition-named oblique for the ground of a thanking (the "commended for the salvage" case, not Beneficiary), and the tenseless agree/come events follow the control-verb and argument-PP rules as written.
